title: FreeCam
features: FreeCam, No Limit, No Key, open source.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local p = Players.LocalPlayer

RunService:BindToRenderStep("ForceCameraUnlock", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()

    p.DevEnableMouseLock = true
    p.DevComputerCameraMode = Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.UserChoice
    p.DevComputerMovementMode = Enum.DevComputerMovementMode.UserChoice
    p.DevCameraOcclusionMode = Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Zoom

    p.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic

    p.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0
    p.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 1000000

end)
